Headline: #34 South Michigan Temporary Reroute near 130th/Eberhart
ShortDescription: 34 South Michigan buses are temporarily rerouted in both directions due to, street blockage near 130th/Eberhart.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
How does this affect my trip?

#34 South Michigan buses are temporarily rerouted in both directions:

Southbound buses will operate via 130th, Indiana, 134th, Langley, 131st, then resume their normal route.

Northbound buses will operate via 133rd Street, 133rd Place, 134th, Indiana, 130th, then resume their normal route.

Allow extra travel time.

Why is service being changed?

Buses are rerouted due to street blockage near 130th/Eberhart.
